list.name: card
list.label: Картка
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT last4 FROM transactions ORDER BY last4

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-amount),0)/100.0 AS "Витрати" FROM transactions t WHERE amount < 0 AND operated_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND last4 IN ($card) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcc_categories mc WHERE mc.mcc = t.mcc AND mc.is_spending = false)

panels.title: Дохід за період
panels.description: Надходження без переказів між власними картками (зарплата, перекази від інших, кешбек).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0)/100.0 AS "Дохід" FROM transactions WHERE amount > 0 AND operated_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND last4 IN ($card) AND description NOT ILIKE '%своєї картки%' AND description NOT ILIKE '%Voloshenko%' AND description NOT ILIKE '%зняття банки%'

panels.title: Надходження за період (усі)
panels.description: Усі додатні транзакції разом, включно з переказами між власними картками.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0)/100.0 AS "Надходження" FROM transactions WHERE amount > 0 AND operated_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND last4 IN ($card)

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(-amount),0)/100.0 AS "Середня" FROM transactions t WHERE amount < 0 AND operated_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND last4 IN ($card) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcc_categories mc WHERE mc.mcc = t.mcc AND mc.is_spending = false)

SELECT date_trunc('month', operated_at) AS time, SUM(-amount)/100.0 AS "Витрати" FROM transactions t WHERE amount < 0 AND operated_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND last4 IN ($card) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcc_categories mc WHERE mc.mcc = t.mcc AND mc.is_spending = false) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(c.label, t.bank || ' ****' || t.last4) AS "Картка", SUM(-t.amount)/100.0 AS "Витрати" FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.last4 = t.last4 AND c.bank = t.bank WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.operated_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND t.last4 IN ($card) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcc_categories mc WHERE mc.mcc = t.mcc AND mc.is_spending = false) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT COALESCE(mc.category, 'Інше') AS "Категорія", SUM(-t.amount)/100.0 AS "Витрати" FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN mcc_categories mc ON mc.mcc = t.mcc WHERE t.amount < 0 AND t.operated_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND t.last4 IN ($card) AND COALESCE(mc.is_spending, true) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT operated_at AS "Дата", description AS "Опис", bank AS "Банк", last4 AS "Картка", (-amount)/100.0 AS "Сума" FROM transactions t WHERE amount < 0 AND operated_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND last4 IN ($card) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcc_categories mc WHERE mc.mcc = t.mcc AND mc.is_spending = false) ORDER BY amount ASC LIMIT 25
